title: Mars rovers
examples: What are the main jobs of the Mars rovers?
How long does it take for messages to reach Mars?
What did the Curiosity rover find on Mars?

explain.say: Today we learn about rovers on Mars. These robots help us explore another planet.

draw.text: Mars Rovers: Exploring the Red Planet

explain.say: The Curiosity rover studied old lake beds. It looked for signs of water once there.
The Perseverance rover collects rock samples. It stores them for a future return to Earth.
Scientists use rovers to search for signs of past life. They look for ancient signs of living things.
Because Mars is far away, signals take time to reach us. This is called signal delay.
In real life, talking to a friend on a video call shows delay. You might wait a moment for their words.

faq.q: How far away is Mars from Earth?
faq.a: Mars is a very large distance away from Earth. The distance changes a lot depending on where the planets are in their orbits.
asks: What is the distance between Earth and Mars?

faq.q: Can the rovers survive on Mars?
faq.a: The rovers are very tough machines. They are built to handle the dust and the cold temperatures on Mars.
asks: What is the Martian environment like?

faq.a: Signal delay means that radio messages take time to travel across space. This delay makes talking feel slow.
asks: Why is communication slow from Mars?

faq.q: What are the rovers looking for?
faq.a: The rovers are mainly looking for evidence of water and signs that life might have existed long ago.
asks: What is the goal of the missions?

faq.q: What is the difference between Curiosity and Perseverance?
faq.a: They are both rovers, but they have different tools and focus areas. Perseverance is currently collecting samples.

facts: Mars rovers are robotic vehicles designed to explore other planets.
Curiosity studied ancient lake beds to find signs of past water.
Perseverance is collecting rock samples for a future return to Earth.
Because of the distance, communication signals have a noticeable delay.

quiz.say: Which rover is currently focused on collecting rock samples?
quiz.why: Perseverance is specifically designed to cache rock samples for later study.

wrong.0: Curiosity focused more on analyzing the chemistry of past environments.
wrong.1: Earth is our home planet, not a rover.
wrong.2: Signal delay is a time issue, not a rover name.

quiz.say: If a message takes time to reach Mars, what is this time difference called?
quiz.why: Signal delay is the scientific term for the time gap due to distance.

wrong.0: Orbital period measures how long one planet takes to circle the sun.
wrong.1: Light speed is how fast the signal travels, not the delay itself.
wrong.3: Time warp is a science fiction idea, not a real measurement.

quiz.say: What evidence are rovers primarily searching for on Mars?

options.show: Signs of past water and life
options.say: Signs of past water and life

quiz.why: The main scientific goals are finding evidence of liquid water and potential life.

wrong.0: They are looking for ancient biological signs, not modern civilizations.
wrong.1: Volcanoes are geological features, but the focus is on habitability.
wrong.3: While valuable, rovers are looking for biological signs, not just minerals.
